name: University of California, Irvine
character: The core campus forms a rough circle centered on Aldrich Park, featuring an urban forest of 30,000 trees, hilly terrain, and coastal sage scrub.

landmarks.name: Aldrich Park
landmarks.quote: The layout of the core campus resembles a rough circle with its center being Aldrich Park
landmarks.look: Circular central park filled with diverse trees and pathways.

landmarks.look: Circular pedestrian walkway lined with campus buildings.

landmarks.name: Langson Library
landmarks.quote: Langson Library hosts an extensive East Asian collection
